jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Senior Consultant
jobs.description: Role Summary We are looking for a hands-on Applied AI Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and productionise Generative AI and agentic applications across our product and solution portfolio. The role is centred on AI application engineering: turning foundation models into reliable systems that can reason, use tools, retrieve information, collaborate across agents, and complete complex business workflows. We are particularly interested in engineers who have built real multi-agent systems with explicit orchestration, state and context management, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, observability, and failure handling. You may have used frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or comparable frameworks and developer tooling. Key Responsibilities Design and build Generative AI applications, autonomous agents, and multi-agent systems that solve real business problems across industries. Design agent orchestration patterns including supervisors and worker agents, routing, delegation, planning, tool selection, state management, memory, retries, fallbacks, and human approval points. Build agents that interact safely with enterprise data and systems through APIs, functions, retrieval, databases, vector stores, MCP servers, and other governed tools. Work with leading foundation models and model APIs, selecting appropriate models and designing effective prompts, structured outputs, tool schemas, context strategies, and model fallbacks. Build evaluation harnesses and test suites for agent quality, task completion, tool selection, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, and regression detection. Implement tracing, logging, observability, feedback loops, guardrails, and debugging approaches that make complex agent behaviour understandable and supportable in production. Prototype rapidly using modern AI SDKs and coding agents, then turn successful prototypes into maintainable, secure, production-grade applications. Work with product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and client teams to integrate AI systems into real workflows and enterprise environments. Continuously evaluate new models, agent frameworks, protocols, and development patterns, and turn useful capabilities into reusable engineering components. What We're Looking For We care more about evidence that you have built and debugged working AI systems than about a particular job title. Strong software engineering and AI application fundamentals are the priority. Approximately 2-6 years of software, ML, AI, or product engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on work with Generative AI or LLM-powered applications. Strong Python programming skills and good software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, Git, packaging, and debugging. Solid understanding of LLM concepts including tokens and context windows, system and user prompts, structured outputs, tool/function calling, embeddings, retrieval, model selection, temperature and sampling, latency, and inference cost. Hands-on experience building agents or multi-agent systems using at least one modern framework such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar. Experience implementing explicit agent orchestration rather than only prompt chains or chatbots, including state, routing, delegation, tool permissions, retries, checkpoints, and failure recovery. Experience with RAG and grounding patterns using enterprise documents, structured data, vector search, semantic search, or knowledge stores. Experience integrating LLM applications with external APIs, business systems, databases, and developer tools; familiarity with MCP is valuable. Understanding of AI evaluation techniques, including task-based evals, LLM-as-judge where appropriate, deterministic checks, test datasets, tracing, and regression testing. Understanding of production concerns including prompt injection, data leakage, access control, secrets, rate limits, token budgets, latency, reliability, observability, and cost management. Ability to investigate ambiguous model or agent failures systematically and improve behaviour through changes to prompts, context, tools, orchestration, models, or application logic. Agentic AI Experience Built a multi-step or multi-agent system in which multiple specialised agents coordinate through an orchestrator, supervisor, graph, workflow, or shared state. Experience designing tool-using agents that take actions rather than only generate text, with controls around what each agent can access and execute. Familiarity with modern agent development environments and AI coding tools such as Google ADK, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and related SDKs or command-line development workflows. Experience with durable execution concepts such as checkpoints, resumability, idempotency, timeouts, retries, error routing, long-running tasks, and human-in-the-loop review. Experience instrumenting agent traces and using evaluations and production feedback to understand failure modes and improve solve rate, reliability, usefulness, and cost. Ability to explain the architecture of an agentic system end-to-end, including model choice, orchestration, state, memory, tools, identity, permissions, evaluation, monitoring, deployment, and operational support. Nice to Have Experience building agentic solutions within Databricks or Snowflake, including governed access to enterprise data, models, functions, or tools. Exposure to Databricks Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search, AI Gateway / Unity Gateway, or Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and Cortex AI Gateway. Experience with MLflow, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar evaluation and observability tooling. Experience with vector databases or search platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or cloud-native equivalents. Familiarity with cloud AI services and model platforms across AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with enterprise authentication and security patterns. Experience deploying AI services using FastAPI, containers, serverless platforms, or Kubernetes, and integrating them into web or enterprise applications. Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation, synthetic data generation, or advanced retrieval techniques is useful but not required. What Success Looks Like You can take an ambiguous business problem and build an AI system that goes beyond a demo to complete meaningful tasks reliably. You can design and implement a multi-agent architecture with explicit orchestration, governed tools, state, evaluation, observability, and failure handling. You can diagnose why an agent fails on real tasks and improve the system using evidence from traces, evals, user feedback, and production behaviour. You make pragmatic choices between a simple deterministic workflow, a single agent, and a multi-agent system rather than adding agents where they are unnecessary. You create reusable technical patterns that help multiple product teams build safer and more reliable AI applications. What We Offer Opportunity to build AI, data, analytics, and digital products across Retail & CPG, Media & Entertainment, Sports, Energy, Telecommunications, and other industries. Hands-on work with frontier and enterprise foundation models, modern agent frameworks, and emerging AI development patterns. Opportunity to take AI solutions from prototypes through evaluation, enterprise integration, production deployment, and continuous improvement. Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, and modern cloud-native AI technologies without being constrained to a single platform. A development path toward Senior Applied AI Engineer, AI Architect, Agentic AI Lead, or technical leadership roles. About EXL EXL (NASDAQ:EXLS) is a global data and AI company that helps clients improve business outcomes through data, analytics, AI, digital solutions, and operations. Our teams work with organisations across industries to design, build, and deploy technology-driven solutions addressing complex business problems. jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary About the Role: GSK s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work - embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies - Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI - and this role brings that model to GSK. This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams - product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU - to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis - not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations - clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role. Why This Role Exists: Enterprise AI s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs - fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer. Proves AI ideas fast - shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed. Works directly inside the business - not at arm s length - building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI. Builds the organisation s reusable AI engineering assets - every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from. Key Responsibilities PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery: Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. This data forms the building blocks for understanding user journeys: what products users search for, which features they see and use, and which marketing channels they arrive from. It powers analysis of Product and Marketing performance to support optimized decision-making and can also be used programmatically to drive personalized, adaptive experiences for our users. You are collaborative, creative, and thrive in a dynamic, agile environment where you continuously learn and raise the bar. Implement robust testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure reliability and rapid incident response. Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive long-term fixes and improvements. Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to deliver high-impact solutions. Stay current with advancements in cloud data platforms, streaming technologies, and best practices; mentor junior engineers. Experience building production-grade data processing applications in public/hybrid cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure). Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems, and design patterns. Proficiency in testing strategies (unit, integration), CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident management. Familiarity with observability concepts and tools to monitor application health and performance. Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; self-starter with a learning mindset. Familiarity with basic AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, code assistants) to accelerate development or documentation, used responsibly within company policies. Job Knowledge, Skill and Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 3-6 years of application development experience, including strong hands-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
